title: Vallerieon
summary: A personal media gallery with a complete publishing workflow.
description: A gallery for photos, videos, and music with a public experience and a separate admin panel. The project includes uploads, content editing, serverless API routes, and cloud storage through Vercel Blob.

title: Nutrimind
summary: An AI-assisted meal generator built around nutrition data.
description: A Flask application that combines food and nutrition data with AI-assisted meal generation. It explores a practical use of language and vision models rather than adding a chatbot to an otherwise ordinary interface.

title: Kopi Malas
summary: A scroll-led company profile for a local coffee brand.
description: A compact brand site for Kopi Malas. The build uses deliberate motion, smooth scrolling, and a simple product narrative to give a small business a more memorable web presence.

title: QR Attendance
summary: A browser-based attendance flow using QR codes and Firebase.
description: A React prototype for creating, scanning, and recording attendance through QR codes. Firebase handles the data layer while the interface is optimized for the short, repeatable flow of checking in.

title: Split TheBill
summary: A shared-subscription platform built as a team project.
description: A platform for coordinating shared digital subscriptions and splitting their cost across members. I worked with the team on the Laravel application and its Bootstrap-based interface.

title: MelodyTix
summary: A concert discovery and ticketing prototype.
description: A group-built web application for browsing concerts and purchasing tickets. The project covers the complete ticketing flow, from event discovery to order management, in a PHP application.

title: StreamFlix
summary: A streaming product concept focused on independent films.
description: A product design concept for an Indonesian independent-film platform. The interface gives local filmmakers a place to publish their work while keeping discovery and watching familiar for the audience.

title: Gizitron
description: A mobile interface concept for estimating calories, logging meals, and turning food data into useful daily guidance. The work focused on making dense nutrition information quick to read.
